ambient_events: A shelf of dead flashlights waits under a sign that reads: TESTED. MOSTLY.
Somewhere in the back a battery charger ticks and clicks to itself.
description: A cramped front room built out of corrugated sheet and honest intentions. Scavenged crates form a counter down the middle, and every nail in reach hangs with flashlights, coils of spare cells, canteens and folded work clothes. A strip of salvaged emergency lighting keeps the place lit even when the block goes dark — which, Grady will tell you, is the entire point.
name: Two-Cell Supply
